title: Unauthenticated SSRF via azure RemoteConf type bypasses the FetchAndWriteNeedle endpoint guard
summary:
## Summary
`VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle` fetches a caller-supplied remote endpoint. CVE-2026-73080 (GHSA-87fv-vqqr-m4jr) added an SSRF endpoint deny-list + rebinding-safe pinned dialer, and the follow-up refactor routes the guard through `S3CompatibleEndpoint(remoteConf)`. The `azure` backend has **no `case "azure"`** in that switch, so it takes the unguarded `else` branch and reaches the azblob download sink with an attacker-supplied endpoint. This is a DISTINCT variant from GHSA-8wr4-8f39-p7x2 (which covers only the 9 S3-SDK backends via `aws-sdk-go`): azure uses a different SDK (`azure-sdk-for-go/.../azblob`), a different field (`AzureEndpoint`), a different constructor (`NewAzBlobClient`), and requires a different fix.

## Root Cause
`weed/server/volume_grpc_remote.go`: `endpoint, isS3Compatible = s3remote.S3CompatibleEndpoint(remoteConf)` (line 244); the deny-list + guarded dialer run only inside `if !vs.AllowUntrustedRemoteEndpoints && isS3Compatible` (line 249). `s3CompatibleClientOptions` (`weed/remote_storage/s3/s3_storage_client.go:68`) switches on `conf.Type` with cases for `s3, aliyun, b2, baidu, contabo, filebase, storj, tencent, wasabi` - **no `azure`** - so `isS3Compatible=false` and azure falls to the `else` at line 260: `remote_storage.GetRemoteStorage(remoteConf)` → `azureRemoteStorageMaker.Make` → `NewAzBlobClient(accountName, accountKey, clientId, conf.AzureEndpoint)`. The only endpoint validation is `azureServiceURL` (`weed/remote_storage/azure/azure_credentials.go:71-84`), which checks solely `url.Parse` success, `Scheme=="https"`, and non-empty `Hostname()`. No loopback / link-local / RFC1918 / IMDS deny-list exists on this path (contrast `checkBlockedIP`, wired only into the S3 branch). `remoteConf := req.RemoteConf` is read directly from the gRPC request, so type and endpoint are request-time attacker-controlled.

## Impact
Unauthenticated (default deployment) blind SSRF: an attacker coerces the volume server into opening TCP+TLS connections to arbitrary internal hosts/ports and distinguishes connect-refused / TLS-failure / HTTP-status via the RPC error string - an internal-network reachability/port-scan error oracle. Constrained relative to CVE-2026-73080: `https`-only (`azureServiceURL` rejects `http://`), so IMDSv1 credential theft is not achievable; the fetched bytes are written to a local needle and success additionally requires `len(data)==req.Size`, so straightforward body read-back is not the primary primitive. Calibrated MEDIUM.

## Proof of Concept
Single unauthenticated gRPC `FetchAndWriteNeedle` to `volumeserver:18080` with an existing `VolumeId`, `RemoteConf{Type:"azure", AzureAccountName:"aaaa", AzureAccountKey:"AAAA", AzureEndpoint:"https://169.254.169.254/"}`, `RemoteLocation{Bucket:"probe", Path:"/x"}`. The server dials `169.254.169.254:443`; the returned error distinguishes reachability. Use a valid-base64 account key (e.g. `"AAAA"`) so `NewSharedKeyCredential` succeeds locally before the dial. No non-default config required.

## Attack Chain
1. **Entry** - unauthenticated gRPC `FetchAndWriteNeedle` with `RemoteConf{Type:"azure", AzureEndpoint:"https://169.254.169.254/", AzureAccountName:"aaaa", AzureAccountKey:"AAAA"}`.
   - Guard: `checkGrpcAdminAuth` (`volume_grpc_admin.go:43`) → peer-IP whitelist.
   - Bypass proof: default `-whiteList ""` → `util.StringSplit("")` returns `nil` (`fullpath.go:147-149`) → `isEmptyWhiteList=true` (`guard.go:188`) → `IsWhiteListed` returns `true` for every peer (`guard.go:137`). Same default posture under which CVE-2026-73080 was accepted.
2. **Volume precondition** - supply a valid existing `VolumeId`.
   - Guard: `vs.store.GetVolume` existence check (`volume_grpc_remote.go:230-233`).
   - Bypass proof: volume IDs are small sequential integers; any live volume server has ≥1. Weak precondition, identical to CVE-2026-73080.
3. **Branch routing** - `Type:"azure"`.
   - Guard: `S3CompatibleEndpoint(remoteConf)` gating `validateRemoteEndpoint` + `...
